metadata.name: Kimono Watch
metadata.description: Films, series and anime for the household, streamed on demand.

configuration.label: TMDB key
configuration.description: An API read access token or API key from themoviedb.org. Titles, artwork and episodes come from TMDB.

configuration.label: Stream source
configuration.description: The manifest address of Kimono's AIOStreams configuration, such as http://aiostreams:3000/stremio/…/manifest.json.

configuration.label: Country
configuration.description: Age ratings and release dates follow this country first. Two letters, such as US or GB.

configuration.label: Jikan address
configuration.description: Where filler and recap episodes are looked up.

configuration.label: Anime map
configuration.description: The list that connects TMDB to AniList and MyAnimeList.
